title: Higgsfield Shipped Six Releases in Eight Days
status: 2026-10-12: original script from checked primary sources (changelog read 2026-10-12; the release list matches the changelog entries Oct 1-8). Cover capture re-taken banner-free after the consent fix. Third-party figures (run-rate, users) attributed to Semafor and labelled company-reported. | On-screen browser chrome shows a concise source domain; full source URLs stay in descriptions.
credits_on_screen: Screens: own capture of higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog (2026-10-12). Release names and dates are Higgsfield's own changelog entries. Run-rate and user figures are company-reported via Semafor (2026-10-07), not audited.
verify_before_render: Changelog read 2026-10-12: Oct 1 Genjutsu (no-prompt object/scene/character swap, 30+ presets) plus Grok Imagine Video 1.5; Oct 2 AI Influencer (character builder, 5 free generations from Oct 3); Oct 5 Nano Banana 2.1; Oct 6 Ad Multiplier and a 200K-member Discord contest; Oct 7 Film Festival Audience Choice voting; Oct 8 Katana (MCP server for Claude and other agents). Semafor (2026-10-07) reported a $1B run-rate claim and 30M users — always voiced as company-reported, never as audited fact. Count 'six releases' = Genjutsu, Grok Imagine Video 1.5, AI Influencer, Nano Banana 2.1, Ad Multiplier, Katana (Film Festival vote and Discord contest are events, not releases).

Region names used here exist in captures/tool-higgsfield-01/manifest.json and sit inside the desktop-top viewport (y+h <= 900 CSS): title_katana {562,364,679,32}, readme {302,364,939,492}, date_oct-8-2026 {340,364,126,30}.
No on-screen credit captions. Option 3 Chatterbox Michael continuous-flow voice required.

scenes.heading: HIGGSFIELD SHIPPED *SIX* RELEASES IN EIGHT DAYS
scenes.say: While everyone watched the big labs, Higgsfield shipped {6|six} releases in eight days. This is the changelog.
The newest is Katana, out October eighth: an MCP server that lets Claude and other agents drive Higgsfield's models directly.
scenes.heading: OCT 8: *KATANA* FOR AGENTS
EIGHT DAYS, *SIX* LAUNCHES
steps: Oct 1 Genjutsu: swap anything, no prompt
scenes.say: October first brought Genjutsu: swap objects, scenes or characters with thirty plus presets and no prompt. Then an AI Influencer builder, Nano Banana two point one, and an Ad Multiplier. Katana closed the run on the eighth.

scenes.heading: AT *$1B* RUN-RATE, THEY SAY
scenes.label: company-reported · Semafor, 7 Oct
scenes.say: Semafor reported a one billion dollar run rate and thirty million users this month. Company numbers, not audited.

scenes.heading: THE *CATCH*
cons: Run-rate and user numbers are company-reported
Fast cadence can outrun the docs
pros: Katana opens it to Claude and other agents
scenes.say: The catches: the headline numbers are reported, credit pricing stacks fast, and the docs chase the cadence. The good: Genjutsu edits without prompts, AI Influencer keeps characters consistent, and agents get in through Katana.
Which release would you actually use? Comment Higgsfield and I'll pin the changelog.

youtube.title: Higgsfield Shipped SIX AI Video Releases in Eight Days
youtube.description:
Higgsfield's public changelog shows six releases between October 1 and 8, 2026: Genjutsu (no-prompt object/scene/character swaps, 30+ presets) and Grok Imagine Video 1.5 (Oct 1), AI Influencer (Oct 2), Nano Banana 2.1 (Oct 5), Ad Multiplier (Oct 6), and Katana, an MCP server for Claude and other agents (Oct 8). Semafor reported a $1B run-rate claim and 30M users on 7 October — company-reported, not audited.
Source: https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/changelog
